scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,web,redact "bun run dev:agent" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:redact"
scripts.build: vite build && bun build src/web.ts --target node --packages external --outfile dist/web-server.mjs && bun build src/redact-server.ts --target node --packages external --outfile dist/redact-server.mjs && bun build src/server/redact/gliner-worker.ts --target node --packages external --outfile dist/gliner-worker.mjs && bun build src/server/redact/detect-worker.ts --target node --packages external --outfile dist/detect-worker.mjs && astro build --root web
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n api,ui "PORT=5173 node --watch-path=src src/web.ts" "astro dev --root web --port 4321"
scripts.dev:web:docker: concurrently -k -n api,ui "PORT=5173 node --watch-path=src src/web.ts" "astro dev --root web --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321"
